name: Corrosion / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. Irregular wet acidic bubbles erupt into a pronounced dissolving chemical sizzle, with scattered viscous pops and a sustained sour fizz gradually dying away. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
